messages.author: 112d4415b2bc457c
messages.subject: MSStats Shiny Spectronaut input
parts:
Dear MSstats Team,
I am struggeling with uploading a Spectronaut output matrix (with or without annotation file) to MSStatsShiny. I always end up with the following error:

INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** Raw data from Spectronaut imported successfully.
INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** Raw data from Spectronaut cleaned successfully.
INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** Using provided annotation.
INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** Run labels were standardized to remove symbols such as '.' or '%'.
INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** The following options are used:
  - Features will be defined by the columns: PeptideSequence, PrecursorCharge, FragmentIon, ProductCharge
  - Shared peptides will be removed.
  - Proteins with a single feature will be removed.
  - Features with less than 3 measurements across runs will be removed.
WARN  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** PGQvalue not found in input columns.
WARN  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** EGQvalue not found in input columns.
INFO  [2022-10-09 16:16:03] ** Features with all missing measurements across runs are removed.
Warning: Error in [.data.table: column(s) not found: ProteinName

However, ProteinName is in the input file that was provided and also the header name is matching. Is there a way to figure out what is going wrong?
Thank you,
Sandra

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSStats Shiny Spectronaut input
parts:
Hi Sandra,

I believe this is due to a change in the Spectronaut output. I am double checking now, but we are making changes to the underlying converter and shiny will reflect these changes once they are in.

Devon
